description: Source code for the OrchardCore.DisplayManagement.Liquid module, including the LiquidViewTemplate class, extension methods for rendering templates, and internal classes for shape access and view context management.

classes.name: LiquidViewTemplate
classes.description: Represents a Liquid view template with rendering capabilities and caching.

classes.name: ShapeAccessor
classes.description: Provides dynamic access to Shape properties for Liquid templates.

methods.name: RenderAsync
methods.description: Renders a Liquid template asynchronously within a RazorPage context.

methods.name: ParseAsync
methods.description: Parses a Liquid template from file with caching support.

methods.name: RenderAsync
methods.description: Extension method to render a LiquidViewTemplate to a string.

methods.name: RenderAsync
methods.description: Extension method to render a LiquidViewTemplate to a TextWriter.

methods.name: GetViewContextAsync
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a ViewContext asynchronously from LiquidTemplateContext.

methods.name: GetViewContext
methods.description: Constructs a ViewContext from an ActionContext.

methods.name: EnterScopeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the LiquidTemplateContext with view and model data, including time zone and localization.
